about: The fold (F2, HR-SYN-1): each entry of the folded tables and the before entry it equals (digest for digest), and each before entry no folded entry carries, with the reason. Keys not in "renamed" compare with the same key; a key in "changed" is a deliberate contract change and must differ. Before entries: test/fixtures/guard-snapshot-before-x1.json and guard-snapshot-before-fold.json.
